narrow: The current experiment class permits response means of order \(n^{-1}\) and collapsing response variance.  The added theorem then gives schedule-independent undercoverage, even though both bounded-Lipschitz approximations are valid, so an affirmative answer to the old question would not identify rare-margin face switching or a sharp \(n\kappa_n^3\) threshold.  The proposed question honestly narrows the intended inquiry to a subclass of \(\mathfrak P_{\kappa}^{0}\) satisfying a yet-to-be-characterized primitive nondegeneracy condition; it does not assume coverage.
The revised claim depends on the new response-boundary theorem and removes the false implication from the unrepaired experiment class.
